meta.units: mm, plan coordinates (same as floor_plan.json: +x right, +y down the page)
meta.source: Owner's sketches IMG_1367 (plan) + C1 elevation; glass partition per the BANGYUAN slim-frame reference (2026-10-26).
meta.orientation: Kitchen interior x 4300-8455 (west wall face to yard wall face), y 6000 (open edge to dining) - 8775 (south external wall face). Dining hall is north of y 6000.
meta.note: Hob, sink, oven and dishwasher positions are not in the sketch - placed as a suggestion. Appliance sizes are typical catalogue sizes; confirm against the chosen models.

runs.name: South run
runs.note: Ends 60 mm short of the yard wall so the south leaf of the bi-parting yard door can slide past (track runs to y 8575).

base_cabinets.note: Bottom cabinets 900 mm high (incl. 30 mm worktop) - usable counter top for placing items.

top_cabinets.note: Up to the ceiling (2600). 650 mm clear above the counter; LED strip under.

hob.note: Suggested: 780 mm induction/gas hob over a built-in oven.

hood.note: Slim pull-out hood under the top cabinet; kitchen has no window so duct it out (via the yard).

sink.note: Suggested: undermount single bowl at the east end, near the yard.

fridge.note: Against the yard wall, facing west. 830 W x 700 D (multi-door). Ends at y 6895, just clear of the yard door's north leaf (slides to y 6925). No carpentry above the fridge.

partition.note: Full-height slim black-frame glass sliding panels, top-hung, 6 panels on 6 tracks (telescopic). Opened, ALL panels slide east and stack flush against the side of the fridge in the slot between the fridge and C1, leaving the full width open. Tracks span y ~5862-6055 (fridge side at 6065, C1 ends at 5850). `open` (0-1) is the starting position after a rebuild; in Blender, move it with the HDB Reno tab (slider / Open / Close) or scene['door_kitchen_partition'].

c1.note: Runs the full east wall of the dining hall, from the glass partition to just before the corridor (RC wall ends at y 4450): 1400 W x 600 D (stops at y 5850 to leave the 6-track slot for the glass panels). Coffee / tea / matcha station on the dining side of the glass. Per the owner's elevation sketch: wine cellar at the bottom, drawer above it, coffee machine on the counter; top cabinet = whisky (bottom row), doors (middle), wine glasses (top), 3 columns. Wine cellar (600 W) at the corridor end, cabinet doors under the coffee / tea end. Under-counter wine cooler must be a low (~700 H) model, or drop the counter / drawer.

island.note: Movable island on lockable castors: 2000 x 700, 900 high (level with the counters). Pushed up to the glass partition (~50 mm gap to the panels); 1365 mm aisle to the counter, 700 to the west wall, 755 to the fridge front so its doors can open.

dining.note: 6-seater: 1800 x 800 (600 per person, 3 a side). Narrowed from 900 to free ~50 mm more chair space per side (925 each side in the 2650 mm deep hall); moved west to line up with the island, leaving ~955 mm between the table end and C1 for the walk to the corridor. Shifted 175 mm towards the glass (like the HDB brochure): 700 mm table edge -> glass for the south chairs, 1025 mm table edge -> bedroom 3 wall so people can walk behind the north chairs to the corridor.
